title: M'Mbelwa District Council
excerpt: M'Mbelwa District Council has redeployed Kapoli Zone Quality Assurance Officer (QAO), Mr. S. Zimba, to St. Paul's Primary School in Kaphuta Zone with immediate effect. According to a letter issued by the Director of Education and Sports, Mr. Zimba has been directed to immediately hand over all Quality Assurance duties, records, documents, and equipment to the designated officer and submit a signed handover report the same day. The council said the redeployment follows a management decision and urged full cooperation to ensure a smooth transition.

title: Khonsolo ya Boma la Nkhotakota yachenjeza aphunzits
excerpt: Khonsolo ya Boma la Nkhotakota yachenjeza aphunzitsi ndi eni sukulu omwe akupitiriza kuphunzitsa ana pa nthawi ya tchuthi cha sukulu kuti akhoza kukumana ndi chilango chifukwa chochita zinthu zosemphana ndi malamulo ndi ndondomeko za maphunziro. Chenjezoli laperekedwa ndi Mkulu wa Dipatimenti ya Maphunziro m'boma la Nkhotakota, Alfred Chidiwa, yemwe wati tchuthi la sukulu limakhazikitsidwa kuti ophunzira apeze mpumulo wokwanira, zomwe zimathandiza pa thanzi lawo komanso kupititsa patsogolo maphunziro awo. Chidiwa anawonjezera kuti kukakamiza ophunzira kupitiriza kuphunzira pa nthawi ya tchuthi kumawachotsera mwayi wopuma ndipo kungasokoneze thanzi lawo komanso momwe amachitira bwino pa maphunziro. Katswiri wa za maphunziro Douglas Nyirenda walimbikitsa aphunzitsi ndi eni sukulu kutsatira malamulo ndi ndondomeko zomwe zikuyendetsa ntchito ya maphunziro m'dziko muno. Mawuwa akubwera potsatira malipoti oti eni sukulu zina ku Nkhotakota akulipiritsa ophunzira ndalama kuti apitirize kuphunzira pa nthawi ya tchuthi cha sukulu.

title: Apolisi m'boma la Mangochi amanga Davie Chunga
excerpt: Apolisi m'boma la Mangochi amanga Davie Chunga, wazaka 31, yemwe ndi mphunzitsi pa Sukuku ya Pulayimale ya Mpondasi, pa mlandu woganiziridwa kuti anadya tangale wosatsuluza ndi mmodzi mwa ophunzira ake, mtsikana wa zaka 14 yemwe ndiwa sitandade 7. Mneneri wa Polisi ku Mangochi, Inspector Amina Tepani Daudi, wati kusaweruzikaku kunachitika pa 26 Julayi 2026. Malinga ndi Daudi, Chunga anakumana ndi mtsikanayo pamene amachokera kutchalitchi ndipo anamuyitana kunyumba kwake pomunyengerera kuti akamupatse maphunziro owonjezera. Atafika kunyumbako, akuti mphunzitsiyo anamukakamiza mtsikanayo kudya monyang'ama ndipo pambuyo pake anamupatsa ndalama zokwana K10,000. Mtsikanayo atabwerera kwawo, makolo ake atamufunsa komwe anali, adafotokoza zomwe zinamuchitikira. Nkhaniyi idakanenedwa ku polisi, pomwe mtsikanayo anatengedwa kuchipatala kuti akamuyezetse. Zotsatira za mayeso a kuchipatala zinasonyeza kuti mtsikanayo anachitidwadi monyang'ama. Chunga wamangidwa pa mlandu wogonana ndi mwana wamkazi, womwe uli motsutsana ndi Gawo 138 la Penal Code, ndipo akuyembekezeka kuonekera pamaso pa khoti kafukufuku wa polisi akamalizidwa. Pakadali pano, Polisi ku Mangochi yati kuyambira Januwale mpaka pano, yalandira milandu 35 yokhudza kugwiriridwa kwa ana aakazi, poyerekeza ndi milandu 21 yomwe adalandira nthawi yomweyi chaka chatha.

title: Herbalist donates a fully furnished house
excerpt: Traditional herbalist Dr Chansanga Kamanga has donated a fully furnished house worth K65 million to the head teacher of Dewe Primary School after finding the school's three teachers living in dilapidated houses. Head teacher Tereza Maziya said the donation will boost her morale and help attract more teachers to the school. Mmbelwa District Director of Education and Sports Bridget Nungu praised the gesture, saying it supports government efforts to retain teachers in hard-to-reach areas.
